Power-fail comparator. Below the trip point it stops conducting and R_pu takes PWR_FAIL high, so the interrupt is a rising edge and an absent or dead part reads as 'failing' rather than as 'fine'. PINOUT: this uses KiCad's TL431DBZ numbering (1 K, 2 REF, 3 A) on a plain SOT-23. Shunt references are NOT consistent between vendors in this package -- CONFIRM against the datasheet for the exact part ordered. If REF and A are swapped the part simply never conducts and PWR_FAIL sits permanently asserted: loud, harmless, and obvious on the bench, but it will not be caught by ERC or DRC
